newsitem.title: HUNGARY: WIDOWER HUNGARIAN ELEPHANT MEETS NEW MATES.
newsitem.headline: WIDOWER HUNGARIAN ELEPHANT MEETS NEW MATES.

text.p: Widower days are over for Ahrun, the Budapest Zoo's bull elephant, who recently received two consorts from the Netherlands, zoo officials said on Thursday.

"When Zitta arrived, Ahrun raised his trunk and she responded. I've never seen this gesture before, but it must be their way of saying 'hello'," Miklos Persanyi, director of Budapest Zoo, told Reuters.
He added that Ahrun, who lost his partner Khali in February 1995, is probably assured of company for life as Zitta is 27 and Hella 29, and elephants live to be about as old as humans.
The zoo of the Dutch city of Emmen was happy to be rid of the fairly unsociable females, while their arrival in Hungary was a relief for the increasingly irritable Ahrun, Persanyi said.
